content.title: Stylish Oscars red carpet fashion and beauty looks
content.text: StyleHollywood's biggest stars walked the red carpet at the Dolby Theater.Hollywood's biggest night has arrived.Stars across film and entertainment descended on Hollywood Boulevard for the 2026 Oscars, which took place Sunday evening at the Dolby Theatre at Ovation Hollywood.Hosted by Conan O'Brien for the second year in a row, the ceremony celebrated the year's biggest achievements in film.Before the awards were handed out, the spotlight first turned to the red carpet, where nominees, presenters and A-listers made their highly anticipated arrivals.Each year, the Oscars red carpet delivers some of the most talked-about fashion moments of the entire awards season. From dramatic couture gowns and impeccably tailored tuxedos to bold silhouettes and statement jewels, stars often use the night to debut unforgettable looks from the world's top design houses.Below,
